nodes.norm_label: sound classifier (int8 tflite: chainsaw / gunshot / vehicle / background)
nodes.rationale: Per-source train/test split avoids leakage; targets <=100 KB, <=20 ms, chainsaw recall >=90%, background false positives <=5%.

nodes.label: Detection record wire format (108 bytes)
nodes.rationale: Exceeds the ~50-byte LoRa rule of thumb; real LoRa allows ~51-222 bytes, so it needs a mid-to-fast data rate; sending the signature in a second packet is kept as a later option.

nodes.label: Ed25519 per-node record signing
nodes.rationale: Chosen over HMAC: with a shared HMAC key the station could forge records, weakening the evidence claim.

nodes.label: UDP LoRa transport sim
nodes.rationale: Configurable loss (default 5%) and latency; hard-rejects payloads >222 bytes; no retries in v0.1, seq gaps shown in UI.

nodes.label: Alert overload (problem the agent solves)
nodes.rationale: 50 nodes produce dozens of detections a night for 3 rangers; the agent groups and triages them. Not the main differentiator; without the LangChain track, rules + one LLM call gets ~80% of the value.

nodes.label: Signed on-device evidence (court-grade records)
nodes.rationale: Main differentiator: plain on-device chainsaw detection + LoRa alert is well-trodden prior art.

nodes.label: Tiered architecture: sensor node / ranger station / optional cloud
nodes.norm_label: tiered architecture: sensor node / ranger station / optional cloud
nodes.rationale: Edge AI because of no connectivity, LoRa bandwidth (~50 B packets), radio battery cost, latency and scale; a node sends ~3 alerts a day, so the agent touches ~0.003% of the audio.

nodes.label: Idea: AI Ventilation Coach (Arduino air-quality sensor)
nodes.norm_label: idea: ai ventilation coach (arduino air-quality sensor)
nodes.rationale: Household air pollution from solid-fuel cooking kills ~3M people a year (WHO); must-have is sensor -> decay fitter -> LLM agent with tools, with vision and voice as stretch goals.

nodes.label: Code vs LLM split (exact work in code, judgment in the LLM)
nodes.norm_label: code vs llm split (exact work in code, judgment in the llm)
nodes.rationale: Signature checks, localization, drone math and timers stay in code; mitigates small local models losing the plan in long multi-step tool use.

nodes.label: Decay fitter: exponential decay rate as air changes per hour (ACH)
nodes.norm_label: decay fitter: exponential decay rate as air changes per hour (ach)
nodes.rationale: After a spike, C(t) = C0 * e^(-kt) and k is the room's ACH; only the curve shape matters, so an uncalibrated sensor works.
